Help:

1. Make sure you have logged in to QQ and loaded all emoji packs.
2. Folders starting with the QQ number will be created automatically during extraction.
3. Select an account, click 'Scan Emoji Preview', select emojis, then click 'Export Selected' or 'Export All'.
4. It is normal to find more emojis than are currently shown in the account because QQ caches some packs.

Note: If no users are found, make sure QQ has been logged in locally and the path is correct.
You can also select the chat data directory manually.
